description: This file defines an API client class for authentication-related endpoints in a FastAPI backend, including methods for login, signup, OTP verification, token refresh, and password reset, along with a custom exception class.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class to handle API error messages and status codes.

classes.name: AuthApi
classes.description: Client class for interacting with authentication API endpoints, supporting login, signup, OTP, token refresh, and password reset functionalities.

methods.name: _postJson
methods.description: Internal method to send POST requests with JSON body and handle responses, throwing ApiException on errors.

methods.name: loginWithPassword
methods.description: Performs login using phone or email and password.

methods.name: requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP for login or signup via phone.

methods.name: verifyOtp
methods.description: Verifies OTP for login or signup.

methods.name: signupWithPassword
methods.description: Registers a new user with phone, email, password, optional name, and consent acceptance.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes authentication token using a refresh token.

methods.name: passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiates a password reset request via phone or email.

methods.name: passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Confirms password reset with OTP and new password.
